title: Same distances encoded at Roman sites

tellings.quote: of 5,300 m and 2300 m encoded in Roman sites as well and these hillsides that have the same configuration as the White Horse Hills of Wilshire, England.

plain: The same distances, 5,300 meters and 2,300 meters, are said to be built into Roman sites and into hillsides laid out like the White Horse Hills of Wiltshire, England, where huge horse figures are cut into the chalk. A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm says this without naming a source. He takes it as a sign that one shared system of measurement links ancient sites across the world.
